subject: MAP: Integration roadmap & owners (SDK, streaming, tool calls, structured outputs)
messages:
From: Tom Bishop <tom.bishop@aureliahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Lane <katie@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: MAP & integration sequencing

Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo and the clear breakdown during today's call. As discussed, Aurelia is excited to move forward but needs a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) itemizing the integration milestones, owners on both sides, high-level timelines, and any blockers we should resolve before the POC.

Top priorities for our team:
- SDK integration (server-side library + auth pattern)
- Real-time streaming for live triage events
- Tool/function calling for EHR lookups and actions
- Structured outputs (JSON schema for triage responses)

Can you: 1) circulate a one-page MAP milestone that assigns owners and target dates, and 2) call out dependencies we must satisfy (API access, SSO, IP allowlist)? Our target is to begin a 3-week POC the week of Aug 23, ideally with a commercial decision by end of August.

Also: please include any artifacts we should review (checklist, sample schemas).

Thanks — Tom
Tom Bishop
Head of Integrations, Aurelia Health
T: 415-555-0198
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Bishop <tom.bishop@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Katie Lane <katie@aureliahealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: MAP & integration sequencing

Tom — thanks for the clear asks and for joining the call. Attaching a first-pass MAP worksheet (RINF_MAP_Aurelia_v0.1.xlsx) and a short SDK checklist. Below is a concise milestone/owner roster to start:

MAP Milestones (draft)
- M1: SDK integration (auth, package, example app) — Owner (Redwood): Dev Patel; Owner (Aurelia): Katie Lane
  Target: 2 weeks to dev environment integration after API keys provided
  Dependencies: API keys, test account, CORS/IP allowlist

- M2: Streaming (real-time event transport + backpressure) — Owner (Redwood): Aditya Rao; Owner (Aurelia): Tom Bishop
  Target: streaming smoke test within 3 weeks of M1 completion
  Dependencies: sample traffic profile, expected sequence lengths, TLS endpoints

- M3: Tool/function calling (EHR lookup patterns) — Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole; Owner (Aurelia): Engineering lead TBD
  Target: basic lookup flow in PoC (week 2 of POC)
  Dependencies: sandbox EHR APIs, field-level mapping doc

- M4: Structured outputs (JSON schema + canonical response) — Owner (Redwood): Marcus Lin; Owner (Aurelia): Product (Katie Lane)
  Target: agreed schema before POC start
  Dependencies: sample payloads, acceptance criteria for QA

Next steps / asks from Aurelia
- Provide API keys + dev environment URL and any IP allowlist entries (blocker for M1)
- Share sample payloads and typical sequence length distribution (for streaming perf tuning)
- Confirm who from Aurelia will be the engineering lead for tool-calls (so we can schedule a technical pairing session)

I propose the following target dates (flexible):
- MAP finalization: 2026-07-06
- M1 complete (dev env): 2026-07-20
- POC start: 2026-08-24
- Target close / commercial decision: 2026-08-31

I've copied Aditya and Dev to assign owners on the Redwood side. We'll update the MAP worksheet and send a refined version by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: RINF_MAP_Aurelia_v0.1.xlsx, sdk_integration_checklist.md

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tom Bishop <tom.bishop@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Katie Lane <katie@aureliahealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: MAP & integration sequencing

Thanks — quick follow-up on streaming milestones. Quoting Kimberly's plan above.

Streaming implementation notes / Redwood owner action items:
- We'll need the following from Aurelia: representative event types, expected messages per second, and average & max sequence lengths. This drives batching and KV cache sizing.
- Proposal: we implement an initial low-latency streaming path using continuous batching with a 50ms coalescing window for PoC, then tune after sample traffic.
- Test plan: 1) smoke test with 10rps, 2) soak test 1k events over 1 hour, 3) latency SLA measurement under target load.

Timeline constraint: if we receive sample traffic by 2026-07-06, we can hit streaming smoke test by 2026-07-20 (matches M1 completion window). If sample traffic arrives later, account for a 1–2 week shift.

I'll own the streaming pairing session; suggest a 60-min technical sync the week of 7/6.

— Aditya
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Next steps: MAP & integration sequencing

Tom / Katie / team —

Thanks, copying some practical notes for M1 (SDK integration) and a short checklist attachment (sdk_integration_checklist.md).

Immediate asks for Aurelia to unblock M1:
- Test dev URL and API key (least-privileged)
- Service account with key rotation notes (or guidance on API token lifecycle)
- Networking: CIDR/IPs to add to our firewall allowlist (we will provide Redwood egress IPs if needed)
- SSO: if you want SAML/OIDC for admin UI access, please share IdP metadata

Dev-side deliverables (Redwood)
- Example server SDK + README (we'll push a branch to your repo if you give access)
- End-to-end example that authenticates, sends a request, and ingests structured output
- Integration smoke test script for Aurelia to run in their dev env

Action: Katie — can you share an Aurelia dev endpoint and point person for token provisioning by EOD Friday 2026-07-03? That will keep the timeline intact.

Attachment: sdk_integration_checklist.md (stubbed technical steps)

Thanks,
Dev Patel

Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: MAP & integration sequencing

Kimberly / team —

This looks good and aligns with our internal priorities. A few confirmations from Aurelia:
- We can provide a dev environment URL and API keys by 2026-07-03 (Katie will send the details)
- We'll circulate sample payloads and expected event rates by 2026-07-06
- Aurelia will assign an engineering lead for tool/function pairing by 2026-07-06

Accepting the proposed MAP target dates. Confirmed target close for commercial decision: 2026-08-31. POC acceptance criteria (high level):
1) SDK integration: auth + sample request succeeds in Aurelia dev environment
2) Streaming: end-to-end event flow with latency below 500ms (median) at PoC load
3) Tool calls: EHR lookup returns correct patient context in >95% of sampled cases
4) Structured outputs conform to agreed JSON schema and pass basic validation

We will sign the MSA (DocuSign) once the MAP is final — I'll expect the DocuSign link in the refined MAP.

Thanks for the quick turn here. Katie will send the immediate artifacts by Friday.

Regards,
Tom Bishop
Head of Integrations, Aurelia Health
